# About Our Founder – Jalaluddin Ansari

## Four Decades of Experience. A Commitment to Quality.

**Jalaluddin Ansari | Founder, Teghia Enterprise – Interior Renovation & Building Solutions**

With over **45 years of experience in civil construction, building maintenance, and renovation**, Jalaluddin Ansari brings decades of practical knowledge, dedication, and craftsmanship to Teghia Enterprise.

A significant milestone in his professional journey is his **30 years of experience working as a civil contractor for Canara Bank**. This long-standing professional association reflects his extensive exposure to civil works, building upkeep, repair, renovation, and maintenance requirements.

Under his leadership, Teghia Enterprise is committed to providing practical building solutions, quality-focused workmanship, transparent communication, and budget-conscious project execution.

From civil construction and interior renovation to waterproofing, painting, false ceilings, tiling, roofing, and fabrication, the business aims to help customers maintain and transform their properties with confidence.

### Our Philosophy

At Teghia Enterprise, we believe that quality workmanship, honest communication, and customer satisfaction are the foundations of a lasting business relationship.

Our commitment is simple:

**“Quality Service On Time, Within Budget.”**

With experience built over four decades, Jalaluddin Ansari continues to guide the business with a focus on reliability, practical expertise, and lasting customer relationships.

*Teghia Enterprise – Building Trust Through Experience.*
